alignments.note: Postpositive γάρ realized by the clause-initial For.
Inflected verb takes its supplied English subject under rules 7 and 9; head on the lexical verb have, not the pronoun.
Ordinary negative οὐ aligned to not. No negative indefinite stands in the clause, so rules 41 and 59 do not arise.
Attributive participle rendered by the bare adjective abiding; the supplied determiner goes with the noun under rule 58.
Anarthrous Greek with a supplied determiner: rule 58 gives the determiner to the noun, so the discontinuous an … city is one unit under rule 15, headed on city.
Supplied subject we is a rule 7 helper; after is the compound verb's own particle, no Greek preposition being expressed for rule 36 to attach it to. Head on the lexical verb seek.

The article governs no expressed noun of its own, and the ASV supplies both a determiner and the nominal *city* for it; rules 22, 49 and 102 make both words the article's and head the unit on the supplied nominal rather than on *the*. Rule 103 is the competing reading and has to be ruled out by name, because `πόλιν` is expressed and already spent on *an abiding city* earlier in this same verse, which is rule 103's stated trigger for marking supplied lexical content `added`. Rule 103's own scope is what leaves room here: it says that **rule 7** does not fold such content, its whole rationale being that a full lexical noun is not on rule 7's helper list, whereas rules 22, 49 and 102 fold onto an article by a different mechanism — the article's own determiner slot — and not as a rule 7 helper. The corpus is genuinely split on supplied repeated nominals and neither reading is safe to assert as settled: where the supplied noun is the **article's own elided head**, as it is here, the fold runs about nine to three (JAS.1.25, 1JN.4.3, JHN.20.19, JHN.15.2, REV.3.10, GAL.2.20 and 1JN.1.2 folding, against JHN.1.9, 2CO.3.7 and REV.4.1 adding); where the supplied noun instead heads a phrase an articular genitive merely modifies, the fold is the minority reading, REV.11.15 and JAS.2.1 against GAL.2.7, REV.20.12 and REV.16.12. This unit is in the first class. The contrary reading — `τήν` `unrepresented` and *the city* `added` with its determiner inside the unit — remains defensible and is what a literal reading of rule 103 gives; JHN.1.9's *even the light* is the nearest unit that takes it.

Attributive participle rendered as a finite relative clause: the relativizer which and the copula is are helpers on the participle under rules 31, 7 and 9, and the infinitival to rides with its verb under rule 61. Head on the lexical verb come.

review_notes: All 10 source and 18 target ids partitioned exactly once.
s006 is discontinuous (t006, t008) around the participle's adjective, permitted by rule 15.
s008's head on the supplied city rather than on the is the one materially contested choice; the competing rule 32 reading is named in the unit's note.
